exact_contracts: For DecidableEq payloads and Valid original references, sequential and combined actual appends satisfy exactly the same decoded-row predicates.
A Certificate contains an actual predicate proof. Reuse for incrementally encoded rows requires certificate.entries = oldRows ++ (first ++ second).
Actual three-row length certificate transfers to an unequal packed representation through admitted same-decoding and codec laws.
Checked empty-history length-zero certificate fails after a successful one-row append; old proof is not automatically append-stable.

contribution_roles.role: local formalization/adaptation, controls, source scouting and correlated source review

limits: No full-history evidence is manufactured from old evidence.
No equality of numeric/source/byte identities from semantic equality.
Python/JSON/hash/compression/IO refinement remains open; no independent validation or whole-library admission.
preservation: Previous accepted sources, failed/stale receipts and NOT_RUN candidates retained without rebinding. Development archives .local/batch-certificate/ and .local/joint-graph/.
